comment: The association-set publisher's exclusion list (screening policy v1). Copy this file to config/asp-exclusions.json (git-ignored) and set PRIVACY_ASP_EXCLUSIONS_FILE=config/asp-exclusions.json. Each entry names exactly one of "label" (the deposit's label as text, decimal or 0x) or "depositor" (the depositing address, 0x and 40 hex digits), and a "reason": sanctions, stolen-funds, fraud, legal-order or test. Optional: "chainId" (absent: every network), "note" (at most 500 characters, never published or logged) and "added" (YYYY-MM-DD). Unknown fields are refused. Check an edit with npm run zk:asp:publish -- --dry-run. The format is described in .env.example.
